units.locator: Article 44. Funding of municipal service
units.text: Article 44. Funding of municipal service
units.label: Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Funding of municipal service
units.text: 1. Municipal service is funded from local budgets.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Funding of municipal service
units.text: 2. The minimum necessary municipal expenditure on municipal service is taken into account in preparing local budgets.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 45. Municipal service development programmes
units.text: Article 45. Municipal service development programmes
units.label: Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Municipal service development programmes
units.text: 1. The development of municipal service is ensured by municipal programmes for its development and the programme for the development of municipal service in the City of Moscow, funded respectively from local budgets and the budget of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Municipal service development programmes
units.text: 2. Experiments may be conducted in individual local self-government bodies to improve the efficiency of those bodies and municipal servants. The procedure, conditions and duration of experiments during implementation of the programmes referred to in Part 1 of this Article are established by normative legal acts of the City of Moscow and municipal legal acts.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 45

units.text: 1. Under this Contract, the Head of Administration undertakes obligations connected with holding the municipal service position of “head of administration” and exercising powers to resolve matters of local significance, as well as individual state powers transferred to local self-government bodies by federal laws and laws of the City of Moscow (hereinafter, transferred powers).
